Summaries.eng: When Shiba strolled into Garage Island he met Haru Glory. Not but five minutes later they're being attacked by a member of the Shadow Guard, the current gang that is using Dark Bring to find Rave and destroy it. While Shiba and Feber (the Shadow Guard lackey) fight, Shiba discovers that Rave will no longer respond to him. Instead, Rave has chosen a new master. And that would be Haru.
Summaries.jpn: ハルはガラージュ島に住む優しく正義感の強い少年だ。世界では、魔石ダークブリングを持つ集団“デーモンカード”が勢力を伸ばしつつあったが、彼の住む島にまではまだその魔手は届かず、平和な日々を過ごしていた。そんなある日、ハルはひょんなことから聖石レイヴの２代目マスターとなる。

Summaries.eng: In a town far away, Lucy, Natsu and Happy, from Mashima's Fairy Tail manga, are on a mission to find a troublemaker and deal with her. Due to unknown circumstances they get separated.  The same happens to Elie and Haru, from Mashima's Rave Master manga.  Lucy and Elie manage to meet each other and together they try to find their respective partners..

This episode opens up with a flashback 50 years ago with a guy fighting a monster with a pink crystal-like front. We then go to the present where we see a boy named Haru in Hip Hop City looking for something called Plue. He goes into a casino where he meets a girl, Elie, who's playing and Haru accidently messes up her roulette game. She get's mad so she uses her weapons to tear down the casino. Later, she runs into members of the Shadow Guard, an evil organization. She finds Plue then decides to take him. She runs into Shadow Guard again and they take Plue thinking he's a dog and taking it to a dog track. She goes to watch then helps him from almost getting hurt. Haru then comes in then fights a Shadow Guard who has a crystal and can use carbon monoxide as a weapon. He takes him down eventually and they are escaping from the city.
Summaries.jpn: ココはソング大陸のヒップホップタウン、今日もカジノでバカヅキのエリーちゃん。いきなりスカートの間から現れた少年・ハルのおかげで勝ちゲームはムチャクチャに～！しかも突然変な犬（？）ブルーまで現れて・・・。ところが、コレが悪の組織・ＤＣ（デーモンカード）を打ち破り、暗黒の力・ＤＢ（ダークブリング）から世界を救う運命の出会いだった・・・って、ホントかよ？

Summaries.eng: Haru and Elie, along with the ""carrot-nosed dog"" Plue, met up with a blond female who to their surprise took refuge in a homemade home deep in the earth. This girl helped those esacpe from the evil known as Shadow Guard. Next on her list was our beggining heros! Though things weren't easy and there were hard fights for Haru, but once given the chance he rose to victory over Shuda. Now recognized as momentary escapees our heros continue to embark on their adventure!
Summaries.jpn: ＤＣ（デーモンカード）の追跡から逃げ回るうち、トンネルに落っこっちまったハルとブルーとエリー。男まさりの変な女・逃がし屋ホールの導きで街を脱出し、波止場へたどりついたけど、そこで待ちかまえたのはＤＣ（デーモンカード）の大幹部・シュダ！悪者どもにＲＡＶＥは渡せるかっ！と、真っ向勝負を挑んだハルだけど、コイツはヤバすぎる相手だぜ・・・！

Titles.jpn: 伝説の鍛冶屋　ムジカ

Summaries.eng: Along the way to Punk Street, Haru encounters the Silver Rhythm Gang and it's brash leader Musica. In town, Plue makes friends with the elderly blacksmith Old Musica (no relation -- or is there?) Once Haru realizes who he is, he begs him to fix his sword. Another leader in the Shadow Guard, Lance learns of the arrival of Haru, the Rave Master, and sees this as his chance to capture the Rave Stones. Elie meets the young Musica from the Silver Rhythm Gang and thinks he's the blacksmith they've been searching for. Haru tells her that he's found the real Musica. During the discussion, they are all attacked by Bis, one of Lance's toughest and biggest goons.
Summaries.jpn: えらいこった、RAVEのパワーを引き出す剣・ＴＣＭ（テン・コマンドメンツ）が折れちまった～！伝説の鍛冶屋（ブラックスミス）ムジカに修理を依頼するため、パンクストリートに向かったハルたち。砂漠では飛行船を駆る窃盗団・銀の律動（シルバリズム）と一悶着。ようやく街までたどりついたが、プルーは酔っぱらうわ、変なオヤジにからまれるわで、今日のハルはツイてない～？

Summaries.eng: While Elie is off getting her 'Tonfa Blasters' upgraded, she is taken hostage by Lance. When Musica tries to intervene, he is unsuccessful in his attempt to rescue her. Lance tells him to find the Rave Master and bring him to Lance's house. Old Musica is still having a hard time believing that Haru is actually the new Rave Master. Haru recalls the day he first met Shiba. Shiba tells Haru the history of the Rave Stones. Old Musica still refuses to work on the sword. His motives are not exactly clear. Musica finds Haru and tells him of Elie's kidnapping. Old Musica knows that Haru will need his sword in order to defeat Lance, so he agrees to fire up his furnace one last time.
Summaries.jpn: がーん！あの鍛冶屋（ブラックスミス）ムジカがニセ者だって！？酔っぱらいだけど、アイツはウソをつくようなヤツじゃない・・・と再びじいさんの元へ向かうハル。一方、Ｇ・トンファーを改造し直そうと武器屋を訪れたエリーは、ＤＣ（デーモンカード）の幹部・獣剣のランスに捕まっちまった！２時間以内にレイヴを持ってアジトまで行かなけりゃ、エリーの命は・・・！

Titles.jpn: 復活！テン・コマンドメンツ

Summaries.eng: Old Musica works on the Sword as an impatient Haru looks on. Musica is found outside Lance's house and manages to defeat the Shadow Guard. Inside, Lance's patience is wearing thin. Just as he is about to eliminate Elie, Musica arrives. Musica and Bis battle only to have Musica outwit the powerful, but, intellectually challenged Bis. While finishing the sword, Old Musica tells Haru of his tragic secret. This isn't the only sword that he created. He also made the sword that Lance now uses. The very sword Lance used to destroy Old Musica's entire family. The old blacksmith makes Haru promise to destroy that evil sword.
Summaries.jpn: エリー絶体絶命！助けに行こうにも、ＴＣＭ（テン・コマンドメンツ）は折れたまま・・・。犯した失敗を精算するため、昔の過ちを繰り返さないため、鍛冶屋（ブラックスミス）ムジカはついに立ち上がった！一足先にランスの館に乗り込み、手下どもを一蹴した銀の律動（シルバリズム）ムジカだが、獣剣が作り出す幻に惑わされて遺恨の一撃を負っちまう。残された時間はあとわずか・・・間に合うか、ハル？！

Titles.jpn: 対決！ムジカのふたつの剣

Summaries.eng: Haru and Lance rage an intense battle. Lance's Beast Sword seems too much for Haru to handle. Lance takes pleasure in the fact he's going to defeat an opponent who uses one of Old Musica's swords. After taking blow after blow, Haru finally discovers the secret to Lance's illusions. He manages to fend off most of Lance's attacks, but when Lance reveals that his sword has more than one attack method, Haru appears doomed.
Summaries.jpn: 何でだよ？獣剣を振っていないのに、ドラゴンの幻が・・・！しかもランスの作り出す幻獣は、本物みたいに噛み付きやがる。ＤＢ（ダークブリング）（ダークブリング）"リアルモーメント"で強化された獣剣が勝つか、爆発の剣・エクスプロージョンが勝つか・・・！「じいちゃんの家族を殺した剣になんかに負けるかよっ！」と怒りをたぎらせ、一気にランスを攻め立てるハルだけど・・・。

Titles.jpn: 決着！勝利の爆発の剣（エクスプロージョン）

Summaries.eng: Old Musica enters the fray, holding to Lance. He orders Haru to destroy them both. Haru realizes what he must do and lunges forward. But, instead of attacking Lance, Haru destroys Lance's Shadow Stone. Without the Shadow Stone, Lance and Haru battle head to head. Haru seems to gain strength as the battle continues and Lance's blows have no effect. Haru knocks Lance's Beast Sword away. Now weaponless, Lance begs for forgiveness. Haru destroys Lance's Beast Sword. Lance's men try to take on the group, but Musica fights them off.
Summaries.jpn: 「オレごとランスを貫け！」我が身を楯に獣剣を封じる鍛冶屋（ブラックスミス）ムジカにハルは剣を振りかざす！まさか・・・ハル？ところが爆発の剣が狙ったのはＤＢ（ダークブリング）・現実の一瞬（リアルモーメント）だった！ココからは剣と剣の勝負、小細工なしでやり合おうぜ！一騎打ちを望むハルに、土下座して許しを乞うランス。１５年前のじいさんの無念、こんな決着でいいのかよ・・・？

Titles.jpn: 銀の律動（シルバニズム）のムジカ

Summaries.eng: Musica and gus gang break into a vault. While Hebi, one of the members, is in the vault, he realizes Plue is in his bag! The alarm is triggered and the police end up capturing Plue. Hebi, who was in the vault just moments earlier decides, it's his duty to get Plue back from the police. While trying to convince the police to give Plue back, Musica arrives at the station and turns himself in. Meanwhile, Haru and Ellie are having dinner with the Old Musica. Musica, Plue, and Hebi escape from their jail cells. The policemen find Plue wandering around and realizes Musica and his friend has escaped. Soon, the whole police force is out searching for Musica and the other members of the Silver Rythm Gang. Musica and his gang decides it would be best to leave town, and before they leave, Haru find out that Musica and Old Musica are related (Grandfather and Grandson). Both Musicas know, but doesn't tell the other they know so. After the Silver Rythm Gang and Musica leave town, Haru's sword gets f
Summaries.jpn: ランスを倒し、ＴＣＭ（テン・コマンドメンツ）も治った！メデタシメデタシのハル。一方、銀の律動（シルバリズム）の首領・ムジカがパンクストリートに現れた真の狙いは、国営カジノの奥深くの大金庫。部下を引き連れ一仕事・・・チョチョイのチョイと行くはずだったが、何とブルーが蛇のリュックに紛れ込んでた！警備兵に捕まった１人と１匹（？）、一刻も早く助けなきゃ！

Summaries.eng: Haru, Elie, and Plue find a chariot being pulled by an unusual creature with a smaller creature named Griff as the driver. The group continues north where the blacksmith Musica believes the next Rave Stone may be. After finding a spot to camp for the night, Elie takes Plue with her to a natural hot spring located just moments away from where they set up camp. At the hot spring, Elie decides to twist Plue's nose-- and that deflates him! After trying many ways (which includes pumping with air, putting in the ground, filling with water, and many more) to bring Plue back to his normal state, he is still flat. Griff mentions that a special strawberry might be the only cure. Elie takes off by herself to find the berry, and while she is searching for the berry she is attacked by a monster. The monster threatens to eat her, and then Haru shows up just in time to save Elie! Plue is given the special strawberry and returns to his original state.
Summaries.jpn: 飛散したＲＡＶＥを探して、次に目指すは星降りの地。荒野を旅するために馬（？）を・・・って何か顔が回転してるし！御者の人だって・・・って人じゃねーし！　・・・またまた変な仲間が加わったハルたち一行であった。その上、温泉に浸かったエリーがプルーの鼻を回すと・・・フニャフニャにしおれちまった～！何とも先行き不安な旅立ちだ～！

Summaries.eng: As the group rides on toward Ska Village, it begins to rain very hard. Elie is affected by the sound of thunder. It seems to trigger some distant memory. When they arrive in Ska Village, they find the town decimated by the rain. The 'Thunder Man' came there five years earlier and brought the rain with him. Elie believes the Thunder Man may be a link to her past. She runs off to find him. Haru gives chase
Summaries.jpn: 荒野を旅するうち、激しい雷雨に出くわしたハルたち。落雷の瞬間、エリーに異変が・・・！このおびえ方はタダ事じゃない！慌てて飛び込んだスカ村は、五年前から雨が降り止まない、暗ぁ～い村。宿屋で落ち着きを取り戻したように見えたエリーだが、"雷を操る男"の話を聞いたとたん、土砂降りの中に飛び出してっちまった！

Titles.jpn: ダンシング・ヒーロー

Summaries.eng: Elie enters the Thunder Mansion and is immediately confronted by the Thunder Man. But, to her surprise, the entire location is only a movie set. The Thunder Man -- aka 'Go Tindar' -- is actually a movie director. Haru bursts in and inadvertently slams into Go, knocking him unconscious. Go's girlfriend Rosa, who happens to be the leading lady in the film, shows up. She attacks Elie, thinking she's the Rave Master. The attack goes awry and as Rosa is about to be hit by her own weapon, Elie steps in and saves her. She agrees to have Go stop the rain. But when Go wakes up, he is furious and challenges Haru to a fight
Summaries.jpn: 雷男の館に一人で乗り込んだエリー。相手はＤＣ（デーモンカード）、ヤバすぎる・・・って、人違い！？こんな筋肉バカの映画野郎じゃない？まあいいや、村に降り続く雨を早く止ませなきゃ！館を仕切る女・ローザと対峙するハルだが、音楽が流れると体が勝手に踊り出す！全ての男はこの音楽には逆らえない！え？何でプルーも踊ってんの？

Summaries.eng: Even though Haru has no squabble with Go, he is forced to accept his challenge and fight him. After a long battle, Haru manages to destroy Go's Shadow Stone. With the cameras rolling, Go gives an overacted performance of defeat. Go agrees to stop the rain and brings forth a giant machine that has been causing the downpour. Go shows Elie a picture of the man she saw in her memory. It is Sieg Hart and Go warns her to stay away from him. Back in town, the villagers are amazed as the rain stops and the sun comes out
Summaries.jpn: 愛しのローザをハルに倒され（たと勘違い）、怒り狂うゴウ。ＤＢ（ダークブリング）・怒れる雷（アングリーブリッツ）を持ち出して、踊り疲れたハルに襲いかかる！いい加減にしろよっ！芸術のためだが何だか死らねーが、てめーがやってるのはタダの弱い者イジメだ！こうなったら、ＴＣＭ（テン・コマンドメンツ）で判らせてやるぜ！ハルＶＳゴウ決闘シーン、カメラロール・アクション！

Summaries.eng: While searching for the 2nd Rave Stone, Haru, Ellie, and Plue find themselves in Tremolo Mountain. Will Haru and the gang find the 2nd Rave? Or will Shuda and the Shadow Guard get to it first?
Summaries.jpn: スカ村で聞いた情報を頼りに、トレモロ・マウンテンへとやってきたハルたち。目指すはレイヴが眠るという夢穴（アクムホール）！ところが既に山の周りにはＤＣ（デーモンカード）の兵隊どもにビッシリ取り囲まれていた。その上夢穴の中は広大な迷宮で、入れば生きて還れない・・・。うるせーっ！クマのクセにぐだぐだ説教たれんじゃねえ・・・って、クマがしゃべってるぅ～？

Summaries.eng: Still under Tremolo Mountain, everyone is sleeping until Dr. Shynder tries to kill Haru! Luckily, an unknown man arrives and stops him. Everyone wakes up as Dr. Shnyder and the unknown man start to battle. While they are dueling, Dr. Shynder reveals to Haru & the others that the medicine he gave them made them sleep and then temporarily paralyze them. Dr. Shnyder explains his plan and how he used Haru & the others to get what he wanted. The unknown man reveals that he is actually... Musica! Musica knocks down Dr. Shnyder, and he takes off. Then Musica explains to Haru and the others that he is here to try to find the Rave Stone. Haru and Musica start talking and both wants to have a sword fight against one another, but they decide against it. Instead, the must find the Rave Stone before the Shadow Guard does. Plue finds a hidden door with the ""lost language"" on it that, strangely enough, Ellie can read! It basically says that the Rave Stone lies in behind the door, but a monster also l
Summaries.jpn: 睡眠花粉（スリープパラン）の群生地からハルたちを救ってくれたのは、トボケた医師・シュナイダー。洞窟の中を案内するよ・・・とか言っておきながら、自分から迷っちまった。トホホなハルだったが、物陰から一行を狙う鋭い眼光。もしや、ＤＣ（デーモンカード）の大幹部・シュダが差し向けた暗殺者？束の間の眠りをを貪るハルの喉元に、きらめく白羽が音もなく迫る！

Summaries.eng: Dearhound reveals a few secrets about himself and the rave stones after Haru proves himself in battle.   Not only does Dearhound know Plue, but in a previous life he was one of four Knights of The Blue Sky who fought along side of Sheba and the army of Symphonia to defeat the Shadow Stones, a battle that only Sheba and Plue survived. Returning in the form of his favorite animal, a bear, Dearhound became the guardian of the Rave of knowledge. When all the Rave Stones are gathered their true power will be revealed which will probably have something to do with promoting good and destroy the root of evil so there will never be another war.   The Rave of Knowledge gives Haru the power to attack faster then the speed of sound and transform his sword to Silfarion, which is used on Schneider when he sneaks in to the temple to steel it.   Giving Haru the Rave Stone, Dearhound is free to pass on, but not before giving us a tantalizing hint that Elie has a mysterious power and resembles the Lady
Summaries.jpn: 暗殺者を退けたハルたちの前に立ちふさがったのは古めかしい大扉。そして扉の中から出てきたのは・・・さっきのクマ？「レイヴマスターなら剣の腕をみせてみよ！」と、戦斧を振りかざしハルに挑みかかる！そのクマこそ、ＤＢ（ダークブリング）と戦った蒼天四戦士の一人・ティアハウンド。そしてこの部屋こそ、第２レイヴが眠る場所だったんだ！

Titles.jpn: バニッシュフィールド

Summaries.eng: Shuda shows up with two henchmen to claim Haru's Rave stone.   After dropping Gail Glory's name and destroying Dearhounds shrine to the worriers of Symphonia, Shuda sets the stage for his fight with Haru by abducting them with his mobile fortress Raptopia, in the process causing the entire mountain to fall down on his own men.
Summaries.jpn: ついに知識のレイヴを手に入れたハルの前に現れたのは、ＤＣ（デーモンカード）の大幹部シュダ。身構える一行だったが、突然大地が割れ、みんなを乗せたまま空高く舞い上がっちまった！「ようこそ、わが移動要塞ラブソディアへ！」青い空を爆炎で黒く染めて、ハル対シュダの決闘の幕が上がる！

Titles.jpn: シュダ 天空に散る

Summaries.eng: We start with everyone feeling the effects of Shuda's shadow stone blasts. Plue is hanging off the edge of the Vanishing Fields battle ground, and below on the mobile fortress, Elie is unconscious. This leaves Musica double teamed by Pasha and the Cyborg. He is holding his own, but doesn't get a victory until Elie wakes up from her nap and takes out the cyborg with her tonfa blaster.
Summaries.jpn: 強ぇえ・・・！シュダの操る上級ＤＢ（ダークブリング）バレッテーゼフレアの威力に、圧倒されまくるハル。一方、ムジカとエリーもシュダの部下・プーシャ&ルーガス・７０に苦戦していた。「必ず帰るって、姉ちゃんと約束したんだ！」最強の宿敵をレイヴマスター・ハルは破ることができるのか？

Titles.jpn: ラプソディア爆発5秒前

Summaries.eng: Can they stop the fortress from exploding?   Will the cyborg keep making trouble for them?   Is Musica's friend done with the lather, rinse part, and will he repeat in time to pick them up?
Summaries.jpn: 激戦の末シュダたちを倒したものの、ホッとひと息つく間もなく、移動要塞の自爆プログラムが作動し始めた事を知ったハルたち。爆発まで、残り時間はあとわずか・・・！「あきらめるな！オレたちは生きるんだ・・・！」親父のため、世界のため、宿敵（シュダ）のため・・・生き延びろ、ハル！

Summaries.eng: Elie, a seemingly normal girl, frolicks in the waves at the beach with sharped nosed Plue and the scared ""Please Elie! while Haru and Musica enjoy some sun.
Summaries.jpn: シュダとの壮絶な戦いに勝ったハルたちは、ソング大陸最大の都市・エクスペリメントで束の間のバケーションをお楽しみ中。だが、レイヴの手がかり探しに立ち寄った王国戦争博物館で、急にエリーが気分が悪いと言い出した。何かに導かれるように迷いこんだ部屋でエリーを待っていたのは・・・エリーにクリソツな少女の肖像画！？

Summaries.eng: Elie looks up and finds that Seig Hart has silently appeared before her. The lost young lady addresses this cloaked figure. Seig Hart beckons Miss Elie to follow him through the winding corridors of the city.
Summaries.jpn: 街をさまようエリーの前に現れたのは、１年前に自分を殺そうとしたエレメントマスター・ジークハルト。自分の過去を問い質すエリーに語られる驚きの真実。エリーという名の本当の意味、１年前の事件の真相・・・。その頃ハルも、言いしれぬ不安に捕らわれエリーを探し回っていた。走れハル、エリーの悲しき運命を断ち切るために！

Titles.jpn: 激突！ハル対ジークハルト

Summaries.eng: The fortune teller finds Musica to warn him that the future is about to change for the worse, but Musica is confident that Haru will change it for the better and rushes off with Plue and Griff to find them.
Summaries.jpn: 毒のエレメントでボロボロにされたエリーを、最大級の雷が射抜かんとしたその時・・・間一発、ハルの剣が雷を受けとめた！しっかりしろ、エリー！この世に生きてちゃいけない人間なんていねー！！ハルの怒りはジークハルトを倒すことができるのか・・・？そして、悲劇の結末へ向かって回り始めた運命の歯車を止められるのか！？

Titles.jpn: 封印の剣 ルーンセイブ

Summaries.eng: Musica still running around town trying to find Haru and Elie.   In Elies flashback she sees herself walking in the snow with her father on her fifth birthday. We find out she liked playing games at the arcade even back then and she wants to be an insect when she grows up.
Summaries.jpn: コイツ・・・強すぎる！爆発の剣（エクスプロージョン）も音速の剣（シルファリオン）も見切られ、大地に叩き臥せられるハル。止めを刺さんとジークハルトが毒のエレメントを放った瞬間、ＴＣＭ（テン・コマンドメンツ）が新たな変身を遂げた！エリーを守りたいという思いが生んだ封印の剣・ルーセンセイブ。もう炎や雷攻撃は通用しねえっ！再びジークハルトに挑むハル、果たして勝算・・・！？

Summaries.eng: Haru was caught in the Tempus Alterna, freezing, floating in space. Also known as the Dark Paradise, the Tempus Alterna lets you see whoever you want too the most only to have them die horrifically infront of you, untill you become afraid to think of your loved ones at all and wast away all alone. Haru gets to see his mom, sister and Sheba die.
Summaries.jpn: ハルの思わぬ反撃に、ジークハルトは宇宙魔法の奥義・暗黒の楽園（アルテアリス）を発動させた。孤独な空間に閉じ込められ、自分の願望のため愛する人が無惨に死んでゆくという、絶対的な恐怖・・・。「助けなきゃ私・・・ハルを・・・。」瀕死のエリーがハルを包む暗黒の球体に身を投げ、レイヴの力とシンクロしたとき、ついに魔導精霊力（エーテリオン）が覚醒した！

Summaries.eng: It was Riena's turn to release the power.   She attacked with her White Kiss shadow stone, blowing away Plue and Griff and pelting everyone with crystilized oxygen, which must have stung or something. Musica is able to counter with his Silver Splendor defense, then tries his hand at flirting with Riena who apparently isn't in the mood any longer and gets ready to release another barrarge. They are inturupted by Jagen and his gigantic dragon.
Summaries.jpn: 魔導精霊力（エーテリオン）の暴走は止まり、ハルはエリーの命と世界を救った。敗北を悟り、膝を落とすジークハルトに代わり、六祈将軍（オラシオンセイス）の一人・レイナが襲いかかる！瀕死のハルとエリーをかばいムジカが奮闘するが、レイナのＤＢ（ダークブリング）は超強力。その上新たなＤＣ（デーモンカード）まで現れ絶対絶命・・・って、え？キングの撤退命令？何で二人とも引き下がっちゃうの？

Summaries.eng: The Rave Master crew head off to Blues city. Instead of using Musica's flying airship (which would make lots of frigging sense) they decide to go via intercontinental train.At Blues station the train is late due to the big butt bandits.While Haru and Elie have fun at various places, Musica and Melodia remember past times and their relationship with each other. But Musica decides to rejoin Haru and the gang as the train leaves Blues Station early the next day. On board Haru remembers the great times he experienced with his friends and as more adventures await them just over the horizon.
Summaries.jpn: ジークハルトの残した言葉を手がかりに、闘争のレイヴを求めてハルたちはルカ大陸を目指す。列車で海を渡るために立ち寄ったターミナル駅の町・ブルースシティ、何とソコはムジカが育った町だった。イライラ落ち着かないムジカだけど、いつの間にやらキレイな女の子と２ショット！もしかして噂の元・彼女メロディアちゃん？

Summaries.eng: The Rave master crew head to Lyric Contenent to find the Rave of Combat they take a train.While the Big Butt Bandit's plan  to plant a bomb on top of one of the boxcars of the train Haru and his friends are riding on.
Summaries.jpn: 初めて乗る列車の旅に大はしゃぎのハルとエリー。だが、一見平穏無事な大陸横断列車に邪悪な魔の手が忍び寄っていた・・・！？大強盗団・ケツプリ団が、列車に爆弾を仕掛け車掌から乗客の身代金を脅し取ろうと目論んでいたのだ。偶然、計画を知ってしまったグリフ、極悪３人組と遭遇したハルとブルー・・・。巨大な陰謀を阻止できるのか～？

Titles.jpn: 結界の都 ラーバリア

Summaries.eng: The Rave crew began heading East to look for the rave of combat, but along the way they fell into a crack and ended up at a city beneath the surface that somehow still has a sky. They were accussed of being monsters until they realized Haru was the Rave Master, so they then asked for Haru's help to stop the monsters attacking their city. Haru was about to accept until he found out that the enemy was led by his father. Meanwhile Musica found out the leaders of the city were just pretending to know where the Rave stone was, and Haru began attacking the mosters trying to draw out his father.
Summaries.jpn: ココが闘争のレイヴが眠るルカ大陸！初めて踏む混沌の地をさまようハルたち。ところが、急に地面がグニャリと歪み、ハルたちは地底深くへ落っこちてしまう。しかし、その地底には何と美しい町並みが。「聖地と知っての侵入か、魔人どもめ！」突然ハルに斬りかかる鎧姿のおっさん。魔人？聖地？何のコトだか全然わけわなんねーよっ！？

Summaries.eng:
The final barricade of monsters has been broken: the base of the desert stronghold lies within reach. Pushed to the edge of exhaustion, Haru frantically tries to make sense of his father's involvement with the Shadow Guard, but cannot find an answer. At some place unknown, Shuda--one of the Oracion Six who revealed the truth about Gale Glory-- is indeed still alive. It seems he knows more to this matter than Haru realizesâ€¦

Meanwhile, Elie, Musica, and Remy make their way to Din's Tower, but can they arrive in time to stop Gale from doing away
Summaries.jpn: 「出てきやがれ！クソ親父！！」魔人たちを率いるという"ゲイル"が１５年前に自分たちを置いて出ていった父なのか確かめるため、単身、ジンの塔に乗り込んだハル。行く手を阻むのは１０００体の魔人軍団！その上、ヤツらの幹部はややこしい能力を持つＤＢ（ダークブリング）を装備してやがる。真実を秘めた塔に向かい、剣を振るうハルの運命は？

Summaries.eng: Gale defends Haru from the mole monster that was about to give a surprise attack from underground, then Gale runs off to the Tower. King is standing at the entrance, and meets Gale head-on, showing off one of his Shadow Stones which can release energy that disintegrates anything it comes in contact with. It turns out that King's first name is also Gale (full name: Gale Raregroove), and Haru realizes that his father is not the enemy.
Summaries.jpn: ジンの塔にたどり着いたハルの目前に立ちふさがったのは１５年ぶりにみる父の姿だった！ところが、ゲイルは唖然とするハルに向かって剣を抜く！「ウソだろ・・・親父！？」事態が飲み込めぬハルを捨て置いて、塔に向かって突進するゲイル。その先には・・・もう一人のゲイル、すなわちＤＣ（デーモンカード）の首領にして魔人軍団の頭・キングの姿があった！

Titles.eng: In the Tower of Din, Part 1

Summaries.eng: Separated, Gale Glory must travel alone to the top floor of the tower to face King. The new Enclaim is fast approachingâ€¦Haru needs to hurry and catch up to his father before it's too late, but first: can he survive the onslaught of the five Palace Guardians and their deadly Shadow Stones?
Summaries.jpn: ジンの塔に現れたキングの目的は、新たなＤＢ（ダークブリング）を作り出す儀式・エンクレイムを行うためだった。ゲイルとキングの関係は？ＤＣ（デーモンカード）は二人が作った組織？混乱するハルだが、「時間がない・・・信じるならついてこい！」ゲイルの言葉に力強くうなずき、塔の中へ乗り込んでいく。強敵・王宮守五神がハル抹殺のため召還さえたのも知らず・・・！

Titles.eng: In the Tower of Din, Part 2
Titles.jpn: ファイナルカウントダウン

Summaries.eng: Now that Elie and the gang have caught up to Haru, the odds are balanced in the fight against the five Palace Guardians. To remedy this, Ltiangle sends everyone to the Prison of Spirits, a battlefield that reflects the place most desired by the soul.
Summaries.jpn: 「コイツら・・・強エ！」さすがはキング直属の王宮守五神たち。上級ＤＢ（ダークブリング）の威力もハンパじゃねえ。ハルの瞳に焦りの色が浮かぶ。間一髪、ムジカたちが駆けつけ形勢逆転！・・・と思ったが、敵の隊長ルチアングルの奥義"魂の宮殿"によってみんな離ればなれにされちまう。エンクレイム終了まで４５分、砂時計は無情に時を刻み続ける・・・。

Titles.eng: In the Tower of Din, Part 3
Titles.jpn: 第5の剣 ブルー＝クリムソン

Summaries.eng: The Battle of Haru vs. Let in Garage Island! continue and in the other battle Solasido join Remi, Griff, Plue, and Elie to beat Rionette.While finishing his battle with Let and has to face Raccas
Summaries.jpn: とりこまれた者の心の故郷を映し出す異空間・魂の宮殿でバラバラにされたハルたち。ムジカとソラジドは王宮守五神の一人・ロン・グラッセを撃破するが、エリーたちは影使い・リオネットに大苦戦。一方ハルも竜神（ドラゴンレイス）・レットと互角の激闘を繰り広げていた。「爆撃乱舞！」「天竜虎博！」天地を揺るがす必殺技の激突、果たして勝者は・・・？

Titles.eng: In the Tower of Din, Part 4

Summaries.eng:
Three Guardians are defeatedâ€¦two remain. Despite these odds, Haru and Musica still have every reason to be worried-- as Ltiangle and Raccas prove to be formidable in their own respects, making it impossible to deliver a counterattack.

Now that Solasido has reunited with Remi and Elie, can they manage to work their way back through the Prison of Spirits in time to help their struggling comrades?
Summaries.jpn: 激闘の末に王宮守五神を撃破し、魂の宮殿を抜け出したハルたち。しかし、ムジカは重傷、全員手痛いダメージを負っちまった。「オレ一人で行く・・・親父が待ってんだ。」エンクレイム終了まであと１０分、ジンの塔の最上階でキングと闘う父・ゲイルの元へ急ぐハルとブルー。一方、塔を出たエリーたちを意外な人物が待ち受けていた・・・！

Summaries.eng: With all five Palace Guardians out of the way, it's now a straight shot to King. Entrusted with the Rave of Combat by the late Clea Maltese, Elie makes her way to the Tower of Din to find Haru. Only four minutes remain until the next Enclaimâ€¦   Haru makes it to the top of the Tower just in time! But even the team of Haru and Gale may not be enough to stop King and his magical sword, Decalogus!
Summaries.jpn: ジンの塔の最上階、ゲイルとキングの激闘は続いていた。エンクレイム終了まであとわずか・・・「わりイ、色々あって遅れた！」何とかハルが間に合った！これで２対１、一気に形成逆転だ！しかし、十剣のＤＢ（ダークブリング）・デカログスの威力の前、押されまくるハルとゲイル。そして・・・ついに究極のＤＢ（ダークブリング）・エンド・オブ・アースが完成しちまった！

Summaries.eng: Haru is forced to make an agonizing decision after learning the history between Gale and King and the shocking revelation behind his mother's death.
Summaries.jpn:
視聴する
キングの真の目的、それはゲイルを徹底的に苦しませて殺すことだった！２人の出会い、別れ、因縁、そして母サクラの死・・・全てを知ったハル。ところが、涙に濡れた瞳を上げ、体ごとキングにぶちあたって叫ぶ！「オマエだって悪くない！こんな戦いはもうたくさんだ！」悲しみの連鎖を打ち破るため、今こそ剣を抜くんだ、ハル！

Summaries.eng: After Plue acquires new power and Haru destroys the vicious sword Decalogus, King uses a forbidden power to attack Haru and Gale.
Summaries.jpn: 闘争のレイヴとは、プルーをパワーアップさせるレイヴだった。新たな力を得たプルーとハルは魔剣デカログスを破壊！ついにキングを討ち果たした・・・かに思えたが、「キサマらがオレを闇に堕としたのだ・・・！」まだ戦いは終わってねえ！裏ＤＢ（ダークブリング）・モンスタープリズンで人の心を失い狂獣と化したキングがハルとゲイルに襲いかかる！

Summaries.eng: with the battle ended, and King laid to rest after making peace with his former friend, all is still not well. The recent fight has damaged the Tower of Din, leaving Haru, Elie, and Gale hurrying to find a way out of the collapsing structure! Let makes a surprise return to help in the escape, but the tower is crumbling too fastâ€”the damaged floor falls apart from underneath Gale and Haru, sending them into a dark chasm...
Summaries.jpn: 「終わった・・・。オヤジ、終わったんだよな・・・」とうとうキングを討ち果たしたハルたち。ところが、キングはまだ死んじゃいなかった！生死をもって二人の因縁に決着をつけるべく、ゲイルに迫るキング。それでもトドメをためらうゲイルを、眩い閃光が包む！「まさか、エンソ・オブ・アース？」世界の、そしてハル父子の運命は？

Summaries.eng: Haru and his dad are trapped in the tower and are separated. They eventually get to each other and break up to the suface. The tower begins to collapse and Haru's dad lays over top of Haru to keep him from getting hurt. Haru tells him to get off but his dad doesn't listen. His dad dies and we find Haru at his grave site. Elie comes and comforts Haru...But what about Haru talking to Gale in his dreams?
Summaries.jpn: キングが発動させたエンド・オブ・アースは、ゲイルを殺すためではなく、自らの手でＤＣ（デーモンカード）本部を壊滅させ長い戦いに幕を下ろすためだった。キングの死と同時にジンの塔は崩壊を始める。かつての敵・レットに助けられながら出口へ急ぐ３人。が、落盤に巻き込まれたゲイルを追ってハルも奈落の底へ・・・！大きすぎる試練が２人を襲う・・・！

Summaries.eng: we were able to see the original Reisha Valentine, as well as the birth of the five Rave Stones.
Summaries.jpn: 今を去ること５１年前、王国戦争以前のシンフォニア。まだ剣聖と呼ばれる前の若きシバは、無邪気な笑顔と、人並外れたカリスマ性を兼ね備えた踊り子・リーシャと出会った・・・。ＲＡＶＥはいつ、どうして生まれたのか？ＲＡＶＥという名の由来とは？プルーとシバの出会い、そして過ぎし日の勇士たちの思い出が、今語られる！
それはプルーがハルと出会う一年前。"初代総長"ことグリフォン加藤と仲間たちは、島で平和に暮らしていた。ところが、みんなの大切なキャンディー工場を破壊せんと、大軍をなして襲ってきたプリン軍団！戦乱渦巻く島に流れついたプルーの運命は・・・？グリフとプルーの友情そして栄光の日々を描く大活劇・・・って、ホントかよ！？

Titles.jpn: 決死の路上パフォーマンス

Summaries.eng:
The team get's ready as they journey for the Memory of the Stars. Haru comes back with a lot of stuff for the trip. But before they can go.......Plue eats all the lollipops and Griff eats all the pudding (you'll know why if you saw Origins:Plue) in the store!!! Because of that, they must come up with 100,000 some dollars to pay for all of it! They decide to hold a show for an audience. No one likes the acts they put on, till Plue steals the show with his little dance and trying to catch a butterfly. Money starts rolling in then. Their problems are solved. But........Musica must pay for his medical bill!!! Another show I suppose. ^^;;;
In the meantime, Seig Hart is working on traveling to Symphonia too;the origin of the Rave.
Summaries.jpn: キングとの壮絶な戦いから半年が過ぎた。ムジカの傷も癒え、レミとソラシドは故郷へ帰って行った。星の記憶を探しにオレたちも出発だ！と意気込むハルだったが、新しい飛行船はエンジントラブルで墜落。その上グリフとプルーが菓子屋の店先をメチャクチャにしちまった。スッカラカンのハルたちが選んだ起死回生の一手とは？

Titles.jpn: 空中カジノエーデルレイク

Summaries.jpn: シンフォニア大陸に向けて出航したハルたちだったが、いきなり立ちふさがる資金難の壁。偶然立ち寄った空中カジノ・エーデルレイクでムジカとグリフはスポンサー探し。久々のギャンブルに血が騒いだエリーは、相変わらずのツキまくり、一方ハルはスッカラカン。ただ一人、レットはこの場に只ならぬ雰囲気を感じ取っていた・・・！

Summaries.eng:
With no money to pay the one million Edel toll into Symphonia, or to finance their journey any further for that matter, Haruâ€™s crew is stumped on what to do next. By sheer luck, their ship stumbles upon Edel Lake, a gigantic floating Air Casino that is owned by the wealthy penguin sentinoid, Ruby.
While Musica and Griff search the casino to find a sponsor for their adventure, Let grows suspicious of Rubyâ€™s choice of employees. Unbeknownst to everyone onboard, the Ketsupuri Gang plan their biggest heist yetâ€¦
Summaries.jpn: 相も変わらずツキまくり、空中カジノで大儲けのエリーだが、ハルはアッという間にスッカラカン。一方ムジカとグリフは、資金提供者を求めて四苦八苦だが、どうもこのカジノの様子がおかしい？案の定、プルーを奪わんと不気味な３人組が狙ってきたが・・・突然響くマシンガンの音！大強盗ケツプリ団、呼ばれてないのに再び参上～！

Summaries.eng: The jig is upâ€”Pumpkin Doryuâ€™s Attack Squad is exposed for the frauds that they are. While Let and Musica face off against Lilith and Wolf, Ruby is trapped in a corner by the angry Franken Billy. Forced to surrender all he owns to Doryu, Ruby also learns of his fatherâ€™s death at the hands of the madman. Meanwhile, Lilith lets Musica in on the secret to the Squadâ€™s power: despite the fall of the Shadow Guard, Shadow Stones still exist because the ultimate stone, Sinclaire, was never destroyed by the first Rave Master.
Summaries.jpn: ケツプリ団の活躍？により、ルビーと共に空中カジノを脱出したハルたちだが、何とルビーは帝国門（エンパイアゲート）のオーナーだった。コレでシンフォニアへの道が開かれたと思ったのも束の間、更なる追っ手が一行に迫る！その頃、次々と帝国の町が正体不明の敵により壊滅するという事件が起きていた。金髪の悪魔・・・恐怖の封印が今解かれる・・・！

Titles.jpn: 降臨ダークブリングマスター

Summaries.eng: The battle agaist the Rave Master and the Shadow Guard Master start now
Summaries.jpn: 「ココがシンフォニアか・・・！」ついにＲＡＶＥの故郷へたどりついたハルたち。激しい頭痛に耐えながらエリーが導いた場所には、RAVEの在処を示す地図が隠されていた。大きな手がかりに沸き立つ一同だったが、その喜びをかき消す邪悪な気配が迫る。凍てつく瞳、底知れぬ威圧感・・・。破壊の権化、ダークブリングマスター降臨！

Titles.eng: Return of the Oracion Six, Part 1
Titles.jpn: 復活!!六祈将軍(オラシオンセイス)

Summaries.eng: The Oracion Six is back to kill haru will Haru be defeat stay tune
Summaries.jpn: ダークブリングマスターだが何だが知らねえが、エリーを泣かすヤツは許せねえ！突如現れた強敵"金髪の悪魔"の暴挙にハルの怒りはブチ切れ寸前。ところが、混乱に拍車をかけるビッグサプライズ。ＤＣ（デーモンカード）本部ごと壊滅したハズの六祈将軍（オラシオンセイス）が生き残っていやがった！爆炎のシュダを超える実力者の五人・・・。絶体絶命のピンチだぜ！

Titles.eng: Return of the Oracion Six, Part 2
Titles.jpn: 竜人(ドラゴンレイス)の真実

Summaries.eng: The result of the ritual transforms Let into a human being, forfeiting the dragon body. Jegan reveals that Julia, Let's love interest, performed the same ritual in the past, however she transformed into a dragon, forfeiting the human mind. In a flasback, Let witnesses Julia's death and the destruction of the Dragon Village caused by Jegan. Jegan, who has the ability to absorb energy and manipulate plant life, explains that Julia's death in the past was illusive. After Julia believed that she was abandoned by Let, she turn to Jegan for comfort and support. A year later, Jegan and Julia returned to the village, and the ritual was perform for Julia. However, it was then that she turned into a dragon, rather than a human being. In the present, Jegan merges Let in a tree, using Yggdrassil, causing his defeat. Meanwhile, Berial uses G-Earth to demonstrate his earth manipulation to Haru. Julius uses Armure D'Etoile to demonstrate his ice manipulation to Elie, Plue, Griff, and Ruby. Reina uses Silver Claimer to demonstrates her silver-contolling/manipulating abilities to Musica.
Summaries.jpn: 六祈将軍（オラシオンセイス）の竜使い（ドラゴンマスター）シェガンは、レットから生まれた故郷と恋人・ジュリアを奪った仇だった・・・。このままの姿ではジェガンに勝てぬ・・・覚悟を決めたレットは竜人の成人の儀式・解竜の儀を決行！真の力を手に入れたレットだが、ジェガンの操る黒竜は、何とジュリアの変わり果てた姿だった！非情のジェガンを打ち破れるか・・・レット？

Titles.eng: Return of the Oracion Six, Part 3
Titles.jpn: 悲しき銀術師(シルバークレイマー)

Summaries.eng: Reina is seeking the Silver Ray, just like Musica is. Reina has evidence that Musica has knowledge of the whereabouts of the Silver Ray. Musica fathoms that the Silver Ray is a ship that is configured as a weapon. When Reina was younger, her father was accused of stealing the Silver Ray, thereby was put into custody. When she was older, King came to her, offering the Silver Claimer, which she used in order to seek vengeance against the arrest of her father. In the present, Musica convinces Reina that the location of the Silver Ray is still unknown. However, Reina begins to attack Music relentlessly, using both the Silver Claimer and the White Kiss, causing his defeat. Elsewhere, Berial lower the ground so Haru can see the struggle of Elie against Julius. Jegan and Reina announce that Let and Musica were defeated.
Summaries.jpn: 「答えなさい、シルバーレイをどこに隠したの？・・・あれがこの世にある父の唯一の作品なのよ！」ムジカが探してる謎の兵器シルバーレイを、六祈将軍（オラシオンセイス）のレイナもまた追い続けていた。銀術師リゼを犯人と決めつけ、彼の弟子のムジカにその在処を問い詰めるレイナ。無抵抗で殴られ続けるムジカだが・・・真実を導くのはお前の役目だ！

Titles.eng: Return of the Oracion Six, Part 4

Summaries.eng: Berial knocks Haru unconscious with ease, causing his defeat. Soon after, Jegan, Reina, and Berial observe the match between Elie and Julius. Catching Julius off guard, she manage to use her tonfa blasters at his face. Julius become aggressive, experiencing a temper tantrum. Griff attempts to run away, however Julius encased Elie in a coat of ice and launches her at Griff, Elie manages to break free, but she injures her arm in the process. Julius approaches Elie with a sword of ice, prepared to slash her. Suddenly, Griff jumps in the way to take the hit, cutting him in half. Seeing Griff in pieces, Elie unleashes a sample of the immeasurably vast destructive strength and power of her sealed Etherion, put the Oracion Six at shock. Haru wakes up from his comatose state and becomes furious at Julius and Berial. He uses his sword with expertise, blocking off the attacks of Reina, Julius, and Berial. However, Haru is caught off guard by Haja, the last member of the Oracion Six, as he falls next to Elie. The Oracion gather around the two, preparing to end their lives. Then, Sieghart Hart arrives and unleashes his tremendously strong magical abilities on the Oracion six, saving Haru and Elie from their demise.
Summaries.jpn: エリーに死刑宣告！執行人はユリウス！！「あたしだって戦える」と必死に抵抗するエリーだが、ムジカとレットが倒され、ハルまで動きを封じられた今、エリーの命は風前の灯。だが、ユリウスがトドメの一撃を放った瞬間、なんとグリフが身を盾にしてエリーを救う！！そして、悲しみに我を忘れるエリーの魔導精霊力（エーテリオン）が暴発して・・・！？

Summaries.eng: Sieg Hart vows to protect Elie and the vastly limitless creative and destructive power of Etherion. With their combined strength, Haru, Elie, Musica, Let, and Sieg Hart manage to cause the Oracion Six to flee. Griff is able to regenerate, making Elie happy. Sieg Hart explains that the coordinates on Elie's left arm will assist on the collection of the remaining Rave Stones as well as the restoration of her memory. It is revealed that the name of the Shadow Master is Lucia Raregroove, the son of Gale "King" Raregroove. While Lucia was in prison for ten years, he obtained power, knowledge, and information regarding everything correlating to the Rave Stones and the Shadow Stones. Sieg Hart says that Haru must gather all five Rave Stones and combine them all, with Elie using the power of Etherion. Using the coordinates on her arm, the group heads north. Once there, they are surrounded by a forest. A skeleton appears in front of Elie, which traumatizes her.
Summaries.jpn: 絶対絶命・・・ユリウスの剣がハルとエリーを貫かんとした瞬間、響く轟音！ハルたちを救ったのは、なんと敵だったはずのジークハルト。宇宙魔法・七星剣（グラン・シャリオ）で反撃開始！ハルのＴＣＭ（テン・コマンドメンツ）とジークの超魔法・合体ワザが炸裂！ムジカとレットも復活し、形成逆転だ！六祈将軍（オラシオンセイス）が退散し平穏を取り戻した地で、ジークが語り始めた事とは・・・

Summaries.eng: The group find themselves within an advance spellbound barrier, secluded from the rest of Symphonia. They send Elie to venture deeper into the forest in order to reclaim her memory. She comes across the sepulcher of Resha. After the forest disappears, she walks back to the rest. She says to them that she had the power of Etherion since she was younger. Meanwhile, the Oracion Six are arranging to construct a new headquarters, to recruit a new member, and to attain Lucia as their new leader. Haja summons the sword of King, and he grants it to Lucia. Haru and Sieghart took an oath than their paths will cross again once all five of the mystical Rave Stones have been gathered. The group will journey and find the remaining Rave Stones, and Sieghart will be a friend and ally to fight against the Oracion Six.
Summaries.jpn: 世界座標ELIE３１７３、それはハル、そしてエリーの目的の地。強大な魔力で封じられた結界の中、エリーを待っていたのはリーシャ・バレンタインの墓標、そしてエリー自身の記憶の一端だった・・・。魔導精霊力（エーテリオン）の秘密、ＤＣ（デーモンカード）の復活、"星の記憶"、残されたRAVEの行方・・・誰も見たこともない沢山の冒険が、ハルたちを待っている！
